I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building clean, user-focused web apps.

In a recent B2B SaaS project, I built embedded usage dashboards in React/TypeScript with Node.js and PostgreSQL so each customer account could see its own metrics; it rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early. I also built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat widget that streams answers token by token, reaching first token on screen in about 600 ms.

I’d be a strong fit for your Angular 12 static pages and the data-driven blog and job pages. I pay close attention to UI, design detail, and clean implementation.

Will you be sharing the current website content and the API shape for the blog and job post pages upfront?
